subject: ACE registration + PDM/PSM intros — CirroMed opportunity
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Alex Moran <alex.moran@cirromed.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@cirromed.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: ACE registration + PDM/PSM intros — CirroMed opportunity

Hi Alex & Priya,

Great speaking with you today — appreciate the detail you shared on the pilot scope (250k API calls/mo, PHI flow limited to inference outputs). Per our conversation I'd like to kick off the AWS ACE registration so we can get CirroMed on the co-sell path and request a PDM/PSM pairing from AWS.

To move quickly, next asks from our side:
- Confirm the AWS account ID and primary AWS contact for enrollment (we need account-level visibility for ACE).
- Quick PDM/PSM intro — would you prefer one meeting with both or separate technical vs commercial intros?
- Security/evidence trigger list — I've attached our ACE checklist which includes the common items AWS will want (SOC2, network model, basic data flow diagram). If you can flag any blockers early that helps a lot.

I've looped in Kimberly (partner ops) to coordinate the ACE intake and Ben (marketplace lead) to help with the co-sell motion and listing roadmap. I also attached a short MOP (mutual action plan) draft — we can iterate on timing and owners.

Proposed immediate next step: 30-min sync this week to sign off on the ACE form and agree owners. Can you do Thursday 10–10:30 PT?

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Sr. Strategic Partnerships 
Redwood Inference

Attachments: cirromed-ace-checklist.pdf (PDF, 220 KB); mop-draft-cirromed.xlsx (Excel, 120 KB)

From: Priya Singh <priya.singh@cirromed.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Moran <alex.moran@cirromed.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 09:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: ACE registration + PDM/PSM intros — CirroMed opportunity

Thanks Aditya — good recap. Thursday 10–10:30 PT works for Alex and me.

Couple quick notes from our side:
- AWS account ID: 987654321000 (primary contact is Michael Tong, cloud-admin@cirromed.com).
- We prefer a single 30-min intro with both PDM and PSM so we can align GTM + what services we should enable for the pilot.
- On security: we have an existing SOC2 report (v2025) and a HIPAA addendum with our current vendors; I'll attach the SOC2 cover letter to the calendar invite.

One ask: would Redwood be open to a short pre-read for our legal/procurement with high-level pricing bands and any standard listing terms for the AWS marketplace listing? That will save time on our procurement side.

Looking forward to the call.

Best,
Priya Singh
Director, Partnerships
CirroMed Health

Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: ACE registration + PDM/PSM intros — CirroMed opportunity

Thanks for looping us in, Aditya — I'll own the ACE intake and the form submission to AWS.

Ben — can you advise on the marketplace listing path we should propose for CirroMed? Given the pilot size I suggest a SaaS listing with a private offer option to start (keeps procurement simple) and enable co-sell later. I'll capture that in the MOP.

Marissa — can you join the intro meeting as the PSM contact? Ben, you'll be the marketplace lead for the listing conversation. I included a short list of pre-call asks below so the PDM/PSM meeting is productive: 
- Confirm pilot timeline and pass/fail criteria (Alex/Priya)
- Provide CI/CD access pattern and whether they'll use Keptn/Argo or native AWS deployment
- Finalize AWS account ID and whether CirroMed needs a marketplace private offer
- Procurement: high-level pricing band + any non-standard terms

I'll fill the ACE form once we have the confirmed account ID and the preferred PDM/PSM meeting time.

-Kimberly
Partner Operations
Redwood Inference

Thanks everyone — calendar invite sent for Thu Nov 5 10:00–10:30 PT (updated for timezone). Joining details and short agenda are in the invite.

I've attached a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that maps owners to the ACE checklist and procurement asks. Quick highlights:
- Week 1: ACE intake submitted (Kimberly) + provide SOC2 cover letter (CirroMed)
- Week 2: PDM/PSM intro + technical handoff (Marissa + CirroMed PDM)
- Week 3–6: Pilot start, telemetry contract + marketplace private offer prep (Ben)

Alex/Priya — please review the MAP and flag any incorrect owners or timing. If procurement wants pricing bands in advance, Ben can provide a private-offer range after the intro.

Look forward to the call.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Partner Success Manager
Redwood Inference
